Enosis Neon Paralimni Football Club, commonly referred to as ENP, is a Cypriot professional football club based in Paralimni. Currently playing in the Cypriot First Division, it holds home games at the Paralimni Municipal Stadium \"Tasos Marcou\", with the capacity of 5,800.
